sloka: अयोध्या निलयानाम् हि पुरुषाणाम् महा यशाः ।बभूव गुण सम्पन्नः पूर्ण चन्द्रैव प्रियः ॥२-४५-३॥
transliteration: ayodhyā nilayānām hi puruṣāṇām mahā yaśāḥ ।babhūva guṇa sampannaḥ pūrṇa candraiva priyaḥ ॥2-45-3॥

translations.english: The illustrious and virtuous Rama was as dear to the inhabitants of Ayodhya as the full Moon.
